# Use an add-on to deploy supporting infrastructure

This page describes how to install an add-on onto an Terraform Developer Portal application using an add-on definition that has already been created. Application developers often perform this task. Refer to [Add-ons](/hcp/docs/waypoint/concepts/add-ons) for additional information.

## Background

Terraform Developer Portal add-ons let application developers install supporting infrastructure to their application at any point in the application lifecycle. These components can be infrastructure or services, including databases, storage buckets, secrets engines, search engines, telemetry dashboards, and much more.

## Prerequisites

- An HCP Account. Refer to [HCP Account](/hcp/docs/hcp/create-account) for information about creating an account.

## Install an add-on

To install an add-on, complete the following steps: 

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to install your add-on. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on your application. 
1. Click **Available add-ons** in the application sidebar. 
1. Select the desired add-on you want to install for your application by clicking **Install** or **Install** another. 

## Edit an installed add-on

After you create the add-on, you can only change the add-on name.

To edit an add-on, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to edit your installed add-on. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the installed add-on you want to edit.
1. Click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel.
1. Click the ellipsis (**...**) button next to the add-on you want to rename, then click **Rename**

## Uninstall an add-on

Uninstalling an add-on deletes the HCP Terraform workspace and resources associated with the add-on.

To uninstall an add-on definition, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to delete your installed add-on. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the installed add-on you want to delete.
1. Click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel.
1. Click the ellipsis (**...**) button next to the add-on you want to remove, then click **Uninstall**.
1. Enter "UNINSTALL" in the **Uninstall add-on?** dialog, then click **Uninstall**.
